still: Close-up of a tall dark oak bookshelf in an old candle-lit library where every thick leather book stands backwards, rough page edges facing out, no spines visible, empty space on the left for the host.
video: Slow push-in along the shelf. Candlelight flickers on the page edges.

still: A monk-like scribe desk by candlelight: a huge open hand-written book with gold letters, quill pen, ink pot, and next to it a tiny toy-like house on the desk on a balance scale, the scale perfectly level between the book and the house.
video: The quill moves slightly; the balance scale wobbles and settles level.

still: In a dim library aisle a skinny student hides a thick leather book under his patched cloak, looking over his shoulder with a sly grin.
video: The student slides the book under his cloak and glances left and right.

still: The old librarian holds up a long heavy iron chain in both hands with a proud smile, rows of books behind him.
video: The chain swings gently; the librarian nods once.

still: Close-up of a big leather book lying on a wooden workbench, an iron clasp riveted to the front edge of its cover with a chain attached, the spine undamaged.
video: A small hammer taps the rivet once; sparks of dust.

still: A chained book hanging from a shelf rail, the chain running from the front edge of the cover, so the book faces backwards on the shelf with page edges out, more chained books beside it.
video: The chains sway a little and clink.

still: A cheerful cartoon dog on a red leash walking on a cobbled street at night, the leash clearly attached to the collar at the dog's head end, a small glowing book floating next to it as a visual comparison.
video: The dog trots forward; the leash stays taut from the collar.

still: A young reader sits at a slanted wooden reading desk attached to the bookcase, reading a big open book whose chain runs back to the shelf rail, candle beside her.
video: She turns one page; the chain shifts slightly.

still: Close-up of the librarian's hand holding a big iron key next to a padlock on the shelf rail, his eyebrows raised over his spectacles.
video: The key turns slightly in the lock; candlelight glints.

still: An old wooden printing press in a workshop by lamplight with stacks of fresh small printed books piling up, a loose iron chain lying on the floor beside them.
video: The press lever comes down; paper sheets slide onto the stack.

still: A grand stone cathedral library at night with long oak bookcases full of chained books, hundreds of chains glinting in warm candlelight, a gothic window with moonlight.
video: Slow push down the aisle; chains glint as the light moves.

still: An elegant dark-wood library from the 1700s with tall shelves and free books without chains, three small wooden-and-wire alcoves at the end of the room.
video: Slow push toward the alcoves at the end of the room.

still: The young reader sits inside a locked wire cage alcove reading a book, the librarian outside turning the key in the cage door, both looking at the camera, comedic.
video: The cage door clicks shut; the reader raises an eyebrow.

still: Two tall lit candles on a dark purple stage, one wrapped with a small iron chain on the left and one inside a tiny wire cage on the right, warm glow, empty space above each for text.
